web.description:
# Guide to long service leave entitlements in Australia
## Long service leave in Western Australia
Pro rata long service leave is paid for service between 7 and 10 years where an employee resigns, is made redundant, dies or whose employer terminates their employment for any reason other than serious misconduct.

## Long service leave in ACT
It will also be payable where there is termination by the employer unless it is for serious or wilful misconduct.

## Long service leave entitlements
- Queensland: 8.6667 weeks after 10 years' continuous service.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_service_leave#cite_note-:1-4) Five years after that, a further 4.3333 weeks. Employees who complete at least seven years of continuous service may receive a pro-rata payment on termination if they were dismissed for a reason other than their conduct, capacity or performance; they resigned due to illness, injury, other pressing necessity, or they were terminated by their death.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_service_leave#cite_note-:1-4)
